newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-JUVENTUS HELD TO 1-1 DRAW BY RAPID VIENNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS HELD TO 1-1 DRAW BY RAPID VIENNA.

text.p: European champions Juventus were held to a surprise 1-1 draw by Austria's Rapid Vienna in an action-packed Champion's League match on Wednesday and conceded their first points in Group C.
Juventus were weakened by the absence of goalkeeper Angelo Peruzzi, midfielder Antonio Conte and forward Alessandro Del Piero but took the lead in the ninth minute.
Christian Vieri profited from a mistake by Rapid's Polish forward Andrzej Lesiak to score after a cross from Croatian striker Alen Boksic.
But Lesiak shocked Juventus with an equaliser in the 20th minute when his 20-metre free-kick thundered through the Juventus defensive wall and into the net.
Juventus, who beat Manchester United and Fenerbahce in their first two Champions' League matches, lead Group C with seven points from three games.
